verdict.rationale: Motion's marketing copy claims you can 'embed Motion's AI Calendar on your website so prospects can book your ideal time slots instantly,' confirming an embed capability exists, but there is no evidence of inline/popup/floating widget modes or an actual documented code snippet/API for embedding as the story specifies. Missing for 10: documented embed snippet/code, mention of inline vs popup vs floating widget modes, developer-facing embed API reference, independent confirmation of embed customization.
